name: agentlens
description: Zero-dependency tracing + waterfall visualizer for AI agent tool calls. Instrument any agent loop, export a trace.json, render a self-contained HTML waterfall of every tool call's latency, nesting, tokens and cost.

scripts.demo: node examples/demo-agent.mjs && node bin/cli.mjs view examples/demo-trace.json -o examples/demo-trace.html

author: edgeorgie
